docs/strategy/2026-08-06-impressiveness-roadmap.md:116:- Compressing an oversized campaign into one night.
docs/strategy/2026-08-06-impressiveness-roadmap.md:156:| **1** | **Complete C1–C7 cleanly: remint, fresh C/D, and stability** | Converts the strongest idea—the instrument and its refusal behavior—into actual evidence. This is the difference between an elaborate methodology and a metrology paper. | **3–6 weeks after desk gates; 2 mandatory nights plus 1 contingency/short stability session.** | D-079 issued artifact; D-110 remint; reviewed frozen-plan record; fresh §5A; C/D split if scope cannot fit. Risk: another environmental or clock refusal. | Reserve the core nights now and prohibit breadth work from consuming them. |
docs/strategy/2026-08-06-impressiveness-roadmap.md:158:| **3** | **Artifact-evaluation-quality release** | Hash-bound raw-to-figure reproducibility is a genuine differentiator and unusually well aligned with JouleWise’s thesis. Reviewers can verify refusals and re-derive results rather than trust screenshots. | **4–6 weeks; 0 measurement nights.** | Sanitized raw-bundle subset, one-command validation/reduction/figure path, locked environment, quick/full tracks, immutable archive/DOI, clear hardware-free replay. Risk: privacy, dataset size, and Mac-only collection requirements. | Decide whether the target is merely open source or formal ICPE-style artifact evaluation, and which evidence may be public. |
docs/strategy/2026-08-06-impressiveness-roadmap.md:159:| **4** | **Designed workload-shape matrix with held-out prediction—Q4/L3** | A predictive fixed-plus-marginal model validated on held-out cells is substantially more serious than “we ran more prompts.” It can earn L3 rather than another collection of L1/L2 points. | **6–10 weeks; approximately 2–3 nights.** | P2-006 baseline sizing, AP-1, 4×3 grid, predeclared holdouts, residual/sensitivity analysis, floor audit. Risk: the simple model may fail its holdouts—which must be reported honestly. | Fund the full designed matrix or omit the predictive claim; do not replace it with opportunistic workload breadth. |
docs/strategy/2026-08-06-impressiveness-roadmap.md:160:| **5** | **Quality-gated BF16/Q8/Q4 quantization ladder** | A clean same-family ladder with error bars and output-divergence reporting can adjudicate the reported q4-vs-q8 anomaly. Strong workshop demonstration; moderate novelty. | **4–8 weeks; 1–2 nights.** Quality screening can run outside quiet windows. | One frozen source revision, reproducible conversions, 256-item quality gate, 32-item energy subset, stack-specific floors. Risk: quality may not be equivalent or quantization may alter cadence beyond existing calibration support. | Choose the model family before conversion; accept a quality/energy trade-off result if equivalence fails. |
docs/strategy/2026-08-06-impressiveness-roadmap.md:162:| **7** | **One mechanism-level study, conditional on a hard feasibility gate** | **Highest scientific ceiling.** A controlled batch-1 speculative-decode or MTP energy result could be genuinely novel; KDA/context slope or MoE routing is also interesting if attribution is identifiable. | **2–3-week desk feasibility gate; if passed, another 6–12 weeks and roughly 2 nights.** | New/forked runtime instrumentation, direct proposal/acceptance events, output identity/equivalence, mechanism-specific AP and floors. MTP currently cannot execute; KDA is confounded; MoE routing visibility is uncertain. | Pick exactly one mechanism and a kill date. Recommended first choice: external-draft speculative decode, because it offers the cleanest same-target on/off contrast if observability can be added. |
docs/strategy/2026-08-06-impressiveness-roadmap.md:164:| **9** | **Additional model families, generic workloads, Jetsons** | Useful corroboration, but mostly incremental unless each addition tests a predeclared hypothesis or provides independent replication. More rows do not overcome the single-unit or boundary limitations. | **3–8 weeks and 1–2 nights per coherent axis/device.** | New model lineage, adapter, quality and floor cells; Jetson remains optional and remote pins are provisional. | Add only a model or device that changes the claim—not merely the size of a results table. |

docs/reviews/2026-07-13-comprehensive-audit/packets/fable-court-holdings.json:46:    "amendment": "Two bench-level changes to WO-005, neither touching the finding or its blocker severity: (1) add tests/test_schemas.py and tests/test_cli.py to bounded_scope \u2014 the verification_command already runs them but WRITE_SCOPE enforcement would block Sol from updating tests its own in-scope schemas.py/cli.py edits will break (verified: both files exist at HEAD and are absent from the scope list); (2) extend acceptance_evidence to require that the re-reduction comparison artifact reconcile the two on-record reconstructions (\u22120.498% scanner vs \u22120.93% Fable-verifier, a real ~2x divergence I confirmed in register.jsonl line 49 and packets/fable-verdicts.json) against the frozen support-overlap/partial-edge semantics, naming the counter-consistent reference as authoritative \u2014 so WO-005 cannot 'pass' against an arbitrary one of two inconsistent oracles.",

Canonical of merged cluster ['C2-029', 'C1-003'] (rule 2)."}, "author_conflict": false, "consequence": "Runtime behavior that produced raw evidence may not be reconstructible from metadata.git_commit, weakening campaign-scale reproducibility and making clean and locally modified harness executions indistinguishable.", "counterevidence": "Repository operating procedure asks agents to inspect git status, and the later publication-pack specification refuses dirty-tree publication. Those are useful outer gates, but the bounded search found no per-bundle dirty marker or run-time clean-tree gate; a pack hash preserves bundle bytes without recovering which uncommitted source produced them.", "dedupe_of": null, "domain": "D1", "ed_table": false, "evidence_refs": ["receipts/D1.json#D1-003", "joulewise/bundle.py:221-237", "joulewise/bundle.py:357-366", "packets/C2.json#C2-029", "packets/fable-verdicts.json#C2-029"], "finding": "Per-bundle source provenance cannot distinguish clean and modified code \u2014 Harness provenance records HEAD only and omits working-tree state at execution time.", "fix_route": "sol-fix", "flags": ["claim-affecting", "evidence-loss"], "id": "C2-029", "member_ids": ["D1-003"], "merged_cids": ["C1-003"], "mission_tags": ["M1"], "priority_note": "normal", "proposed_disposition": "fix", "related_work_orders": ["WO-004", "WO-016"], "row_type": "finding", "schema_note": "schema-note: added post-court for one-to-many", "seams": ["W1", "W4"], "severity": "should-fix", "sol_final": true, "state": "accepted", "verification": {"amendment": "Capture source state at RunBundleWriter creation before adapters execute, and record an end-state comparison so mid-run source changes become claim-ineligible; the current git lookup occurs only when metadata is written after measurement. Define tracked, staged, untracked, unknown, and changed-during-run semantics plus the diff-identity algorithm. Add validation and analysis claim-admission modules/tests to bounded_scope: the present scope cannot implement its own action. Dirty, unknown, or changed provenance must hard-exclude claim-bearing evidence rather than merely be flagged, while bundle completion remains allowed.", "fix_risk": "An end-only check can label a run with source state that did not produce its measurements, while treating git-probe failure as clean or allowing a warning-only claim path would preserve the original reproducibility defect under new fields.", "method": "fable-cross-family-verification", "outcome": "confirmed; severity_final=should-fix; tier_final=3", "rationale": "Verified directly: joulewise/bundle.py:221-237 records only `git rev-parse HEAD`; metadata base (357-366) carries no dirty marker; tests/test_bundle.py:277-279 accepts only unknown/40-hex. Dirty detection exists only at pack time (scripts/package_bundle_pack.py:86-88, 225), which cannot recover run-time tree state \u2014 provenance is irrecoverably lost per run. Claim-affecting; same root cause as C1-003. Routed sol-fix: touches privacy allowlist and admission gating, beyond bench minutes.", "residual_uncertainty": null, "reviewer_family": "fable", "sol_final": "amend"}, "work_order_id": "WO-016"}

   748	        )
   749	        self._instrument_calibration = (
   750	            dict(instrument_calibration) if instrument_calibration else None
   751	        )
   752	        self._pre_resolved_telemetry = pre_resolved_telemetry
   753	        self._post_window_sampling_dwell_s = post_window_sampling_dwell_s
   754	        self._trace_window_margins: dict[str, float] | None = None
   755	        self._environment_admission: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   756	        # D-024: one immutable context, constructed after bundle creation,
   757	        # passed to every adapter lifecycle call. Context is data (paths and
   758	        # identity), never the writer.
   759	        self._context = RunContext(
   760	            config=config,
   761	            clock=clock,
   762	            run_id=writer.run_id,
   763	            bundle_path=writer.path,
   764	            raw_dir=writer.path / "raw",
   765	            logs_dir=writer.path / "logs",
   766	            outputs_dir=writer.path / "outputs",
   767	        )
   768	        # Deferred buffers (D-013): nothing below touches disk until _finish
   769	        # or the explicitly post-window artifact writes.
   770	        self._events: list[RuntimeEvent] = []
   771	        self._controller_log: list[str] = []
   772	        self._runtime_log: list[str] = []
   773	        self._telemetry_log: list[str] = []
   774	        self._current_stage = "run"
   775	        # Collected evidence, populated as stages progress.
   776	        self._transport: TransportAdapter | None = None
   777	        self._runtime: RuntimeAdapter | None = None
   778	        self._telemetry: TelemetryAdapter | None = None
   779	        self._connection_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   780	        if environment_snapshot is not _ENVIRONMENT_UNSET:
   781	            self._environment = (
   782	                dict(environment_snapshot) if environment_snapshot is not None else None
   783	            )
   784	        else:
   785	            self._environment = None
   786	        self._device_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   787	        self._prepare_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   788	        self._runtime_cleanup_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   789	        self._telemetry_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   790	        self._runtime_alignments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   791	        self._telemetry_alignments: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   792	        self._baseline: IdleBaseline | None = None
   793	        self._thermal_pre: ThermalState | None = None
   794	        self._thermal_post: ThermalState | None = None
   795	        self._runtime_result: RuntimeResult | None = None
   796	        self._suite_manifest: SuiteManifest | None = None
   797	        self._suite_effective_manifest: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   798	        self._suite_manifest_sha256: str | None = None
   799	        self._suite_source_file_sha256: str | None = None
   800	        self._suite_order_seed: str | None = None
   801	        self._suite_order_row: int | None = None
   802	        self._samples: list[PowerSample] = []
   803	        self._uncertainty_evidence: dict[str, Any] | None = None
   804	        self._sampling_started_stamp: ClockStamp | None = None
   805	        self._sampling_active = False
   806	        self._sampling_start_in_progress = False
   807	        self._sampling_stop_claimed = False
   808	        # Idempotence flags so the failure path writes only what is missing.
   809	        self._outputs_written = False
   810	        self._trace_written = False
   811	        self._metadata_written = False
   812	        self._events_flushed_count = 0
   813	
   814	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   815	    # Top level
   816	
   817	    def execute(self) -> tuple[Path, SummaryMetrics]:
   818	        try:
   819	            try:
   820	                summary = self._run_lifecycle()
   821	            except _StageFailure as failure:
   822	                summary = self._handle_failure(failure)
   823	            except AdapterFailure as failure:
   824	                summary = self._handle_failure(
   825	                    _StageFailure(
   826	                        stage=self._current_stage,
   827	                        reason=failure.failure_reason,
   828	                        message=failure.message,
   829	                    )
   830	                )
   831	            except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - D-011 finalizes controller bugs
   832	                summary = self._handle_failure(
   833	                    _StageFailure(
   834	                        stage=self._current_stage,
   835	                        reason=FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR,
   836	                        message=f"unexpected {type(exc).__name__}: {exc}",
   837	                        traceback_text=traceback.format_exc(),
   838	                    )
   839	                )
   840	            self._finish()
   841	        except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit) as interrupt:
   842	            self._finalize_interrupted_run(interrupt)
   843	            raise
   844	        return self._writer.path, summary
   845	
   846	    def _run_lifecycle(self) -> SummaryMetrics:
   847	        self._buffer_event(
   848	            "run_started",
   849	            "run",
   850	            f"run {self._writer.run_id} started",
   851	            {"run_id": self._writer.run_id},
   852	        )
   853	        self._log(self._controller_log, f"run {self._writer.run_id} started")
   854	        self._stage_validate()
   855	        self._stage_prepare()
   856	        self._stage_idle_baseline()
   857	        self._stage_warmup()
   858	        self._stage_measured_run()
   859	        self._stage_idle_drift_sentinel()
   860	        self._stage_cleanup()
   861	        return self._stage_reduce()
   862	
   863	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
   864	    # Stages
   865	
   866	    def _stage_validate(self) -> None:
   867	        """Resolve adapters and validate suite manifests before any sampling.
   868	
   869	        When ``workload_profile.suite_manifest_ref`` is set, the manifest path
   870	        is used as given if absolute, otherwise resolved by ``Path(ref)`` from
   871	        the process current working directory. The raw source bytes are hashed
   872	        for audit metadata, while run identity and bundle evidence use the
   873	        canonical effective manifest hash (D-044).
   874	        """
   875	        self._begin_stage("validate")
   876	        transport, failure = self._registry.resolve_transport(self._config)
   877	        if transport is None:
   878	            raise self._resolution_failure("validate", "transport", failure)
   879	        self._transport = transport
   880	        runtime, failure = self._registry.resolve_runtime(self._config, self._clock)
   881	        if runtime is None:
   882	            raise self._resolution_failure("validate", "runtime", failure)
   883	        self._runtime = runtime
   884	        self._log(self._runtime_log, f"resolved runtime adapter '{runtime.name}'")
   885	        self._validate_suite_manifest_if_present(runtime)
   886	        if self._pre_resolved_telemetry is not None:
   887	            telemetry, failure = self._pre_resolved_telemetry, None
   888	        else:
   889	            telemetry, failure = self._registry.resolve_telemetry(
   890	                self._config, self._clock
   891	            )
   892	        if telemetry is None:
   893	            raise self._resolution_failure("validate", "telemetry", failure)
   894	        self._telemetry = telemetry
   895	        self._log(self._telemetry_log, f"resolved telemetry adapter '{telemetry.name}'")
   896	        self._complete_stage(
   897	            "validate",
   898	            {
   899	                "transport": transport.name,
   900	                "runtime": runtime.name,
   901	                "telemetry": telemetry.name,
   902	            },
   903	        )
   904	
   905	    def _stage_prepare(self) -> None:
   906	        self._begin_stage("prepare")
   907	        assert self._transport is not None and self._runtime is not None
   908	        assert self._telemetry is not None
   909	        if self._suite_effective_manifest is not None:
   910	            self._writer.write_suite_manifest(self._suite_effective_manifest)
   911	        self._connection_metadata = self._transport.connection_metadata(
   912	            self._config, self._context
   913	        )
   914	        self._device_metadata = self._telemetry.device_metadata(self._config, self._context)
   915	        result = self._runtime.prepare(self._config, self._context)
   916	        self._check(result, "prepare", "runtime prepare failed")
   917	        self._prepare_metadata = dict(result.metadata)
   918	        self._capture_adapter_alignments()
   919	        self._capture_prepare_end_environment()
   920	        self._log(self._runtime_log, "runtime prepare succeeded")
   921	        self._complete_stage("prepare")
   922	
   923	    def _stage_idle_baseline(self) -> None:
   924	        self._begin_stage("idle_baseline")
   925	        assert self._telemetry is not None
   926	        self._settle_before_idle()
   927	        idle_start_s = self._clock.now()
   928	        self._stamp_preceding_gap(idle_start_s)
   929	        admission = (
   930	            self._campaign_policy.idle_admission
   931	            if self._campaign_policy is not None
   932	            else None
   933	        )
   934	        attempts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   935	        if admission is not None and admission.enabled:
   936	            per_run_evaluation = evaluate_environment_policy(
   937	                self._environment if isinstance(self._environment, dict) else {},
   938	                self._campaign_policy.environment_guard,
   939	            )
   940	            # Preserve the exact snapshot that licensed admission.  The live
   941	            # environment object later gains post-run observations, so its
   942	            # eventual metadata representation is not the immutable input to
   943	            # this decision.  Current strict consumers recompute both the
   944	            # snapshot digest and the policy result from this embedded copy.
   945	            per_run_evaluation["snapshot"] = _jsonable(
   946	                self._environment if isinstance(self._environment, dict) else {}
   947	            )
   948	            preflight_evaluation = (
   949	                self._campaign_environment_preflight.get("evaluation")
   950	                if isinstance(self._campaign_environment_preflight, dict)
   951	                else None
   952	            )
   953	            override = (
   954	                self._campaign_environment_preflight.get("override")
   955	                if isinstance(self._campaign_environment_preflight, dict)
   956	                else None
   957	            )
   958	            critical_environment_passed = bool(
   959	                per_run_evaluation.get("eligible") is True
   960	                and isinstance(preflight_evaluation, dict)
   961	                and preflight_evaluation.get("eligible") is True
   962	                and override is None
   963	            )
   964	            self._environment_admission = {
   965	                "schema_version": "joulewise.environment_admission.v1",
   966	                "policy_version": self._campaign_policy.policy_version,
   967	                "on_fail": admission.on_fail.value,
   968	                "attempts": attempts,
   969	                "per_run_environment_evaluation": per_run_evaluation,
   970	                "critical_environment_passed": critical_environment_passed,
   971	                "reference_provenance_present": bool(
   972	                    self._campaign_policy_binding
   973	                    and per_run_evaluation.get("snapshot_sha256")
   974	                    and isinstance(preflight_evaluation, dict)
   975	                    and preflight_evaluation.get("snapshot_sha256")
   976	                ),
   977	                "decision": None,
   978	                "claim_reason": None,
   979	            }
   980	            extension = self._campaign_policy.idle_admission_extension
   981	            if extension is not None:
   982	                self._environment_admission["idle_admission_extension"] = {
   983	                    "schema_version": extension.schema_version,
   984	                    "policy_version": extension.policy_version,
   985	                    "claim_bearing": extension.claim_bearing,
   986	                    "sha256": extension.sha256(),
   987	                }
   988	            observation = self._admission_guard_observation("before_attempt_1")
   989	            environment_reason = self._admission_environment_failure(observation)
   990	            if environment_reason is not None:
   991	                self._environment_admission.update(
   992	                    {"decision": "abort", "failure": environment_reason}
   993	                )
   994	                raise _StageFailure(
   995	                    "idle_baseline", FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR, environment_reason
   996	                )
   997	            if per_run_evaluation.get("eligible") is not True and override is None:
   998	                reason = "critical per-run environment policy did not pass"
   999	                self._environment_admission.update(
  1000	                    {"decision": "abort", "failure": reason}
  1001	                )
  1002	                raise _StageFailure(
  1003	                    "idle_baseline", FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR, reason
  1004	                )
  1005	
  1006	        if admission is not None and admission.enabled:
  1007	            begin_sampling = getattr(
  1008	                self._telemetry, "begin_admission_window_sampling", None
  1009	            )
  1010	            if callable(begin_sampling):
  1011	                self._sampling_start_in_progress = True
  1012	                result = begin_sampling(self._config, self._context)
  1013	                self._check(
  1014	                    result,
  1015	                    "idle_baseline",
  1016	                    "telemetry admission-window sampling failed",
  1017	                )
  1018	
  1019	        self._baseline = self._measure_idle_admission_attempt(1, attempts)
  1020	        if admission is not None and admission.enabled:
  1021	            self._enforce_post_capture_admission_guard(1)
  1022	            if not attempts[-1]["admitted"]:
  1023	                observation = self._admission_guard_observation("before_attempt_2")
  1024	                environment_reason = self._admission_environment_failure(observation)
  1025	                if environment_reason is not None:
  1026	                    assert self._environment_admission is not None
  1027	                    self._environment_admission.update(
  1028	                        {"decision": "abort", "failure": environment_reason}
  1029	                    )
  1030	                    raise _StageFailure(
  1031	                        "idle_baseline",
  1032	                        FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR,
  1033	                        environment_reason,
  1034	                    )
  1035	                self._baseline = self._measure_idle_admission_attempt(2, attempts)
  1036	                self._enforce_post_capture_admission_guard(2)
  1037	            assert self._environment_admission is not None
  1038	            if attempts[-1]["admitted"]:
  1039	                final_attempt = attempts[-1].get("attempt")
  1040	                promote_attempt = getattr(
  1041	                    self._telemetry, "promote_idle_admission_attempt", None
  1042	                )
  1043	                if (
  1044	                    isinstance(final_attempt, int)
  1045	                    and final_attempt > 1
  1046	                    and callable(promote_attempt)
  1047	                ):
  1048	                    promote_attempt(
  1049	                        run_id=self._context.run_id,
  1050	                        attempt=final_attempt,
  1051	                        context=self._context,
  1052	                    )
  1053	                self._environment_admission["decision"] = "admitted"
  1054	            elif admission.on_fail == AdmissionFailureAction.ABORT:
  1055	                reason = "idle environment admission failed after one retry"
  1056	                self._environment_admission.update(
  1057	                    {
  1058	                        "decision": "abort",
  1059	                        "failure": reason,
  1060	                        "claim_reason": "environment_admission_failed",
  1061	                    }
  1062	                )
  1063	                raise _StageFailure(
  1064	                    "idle_baseline", FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR, reason
  1065	                )
  1066	            else:
  1067	                self._environment_admission.update(
  1068	                    {
  1069	                        "decision": "flagged",
  1070	                        "claim_reason": "environment_admission_failed",
  1071	                    }
  1072	                )
  1073	            if self._extra_metadata.get("environment_admission_failed") is True:
  1074	                self._environment_admission.update(
  1075	                    {
  1076	                        "decision": "flagged",
  1077	                        "failure": (
  1078	                            "cooldown reference admission failed before this repetition"
  1079	                        ),
  1080	                        "claim_reason": "environment_admission_failed",
  1081	                    }
  1082	                )
  1083	        self._log(
  1084	            self._telemetry_log,
  1085	            f"idle baseline: mean {self._baseline.power_w_mean} W over "
  1086	            f"{self._baseline.duration_s} s ({self._baseline.sample_count} samples)",
  1087	        )
  1088	        self._complete_stage(
  1089	            "idle_baseline",
  1090	            {
  1091	                "power_w_mean": self._baseline.power_w_mean,
  1092	                "duration_s": self._baseline.duration_s,
  1093	                "admission_attempts": len(attempts) if attempts else None,
  1094	                "admission_decision": (
  1095	                    self._environment_admission.get("decision")
  1096	                    if self._environment_admission is not None
  1097	                    else None
  1098	                ),
  1099	            },
  1100	        )
  1101	
  1102	    def _measure_idle_admission_attempt(
  1103	        self, attempt: int, attempts: list[dict[str, Any]]
  1104	    ) -> IdleBaseline:
  1105	        assert self._telemetry is not None
  1106	        attempt_start_s = self._clock.now()
  1107	        baseline = self._telemetry.measure_idle(self._config, self._context)
  1108	        attempt_end_s = self._clock.now()
  1109	        self._capture_adapter_alignments()
  1110	        self._capture_adapter_metadata()
  1111	        if self._campaign_policy is not None:
  1112	            gpu_admitted = baseline.idle_window_suspect is False
  1113	            row: dict[str, Any] = {
  1114	                "attempt": attempt,
  1115	                "start_s": attempt_start_s,
  1116	                "end_s": attempt_end_s,
  1117	                "baseline": _jsonable(asdict(baseline)),
  1118	                "admitted": gpu_admitted,
  1119	            }
  1120	            extension = self._campaign_policy.idle_admission_extension
  1121	            if extension is not None:
  1122	                records = _adapter_idle_admission_records(
  1123	                    self._telemetry,
  1124	                    run_id=self._context.run_id,
  1125	                    attempt=attempt,
  1126	                )
  1127	                cpu_admission = evaluate_cpu_idle_admission(
  1128	                    records,
  1129	                    extension.cpu_criteria,
  1130	                    gpu_admitted=gpu_admitted,
  1131	                )
  1132	                cpu_enforced = records is not None or not isinstance(
  1133	                    self._clock, FakeClock
  1134	                )
  1135	                row.update(
  1136	                    {
  1137	                        "gpu_admitted": gpu_admitted,
  1138	                        "cpu_admission": cpu_admission,
  1139	                        "cpu_admission_enforced": cpu_enforced,
  1140	                        "admitted": (
  1141	                            cpu_admission["admitted"]
  1142	                            if cpu_enforced
  1143	                            else gpu_admitted
  1144	                        ),
  1145	                    }
  1146	                )
  1147	            attempts.append(row)
  1148	        return baseline
  1149	
  1150	    def _admission_guard_observation(self, phase: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
  1151	        if isinstance(self._clock, FakeClock):
  1152	            source = self._environment if isinstance(self._environment, dict) else {}
  1153	            observation = {
  1154	                "display_power_state": source.get("display_power_state"),
  1155	                "screensaver_engaged": source.get("screensaver_engaged"),
  1156	                "screensaver_module": source.get("screensaver_module"),
  1157	                "screensaver_delay_s": source.get("screensaver_delay_s"),
  1158	                "hid_idle_s": source.get("hid_idle_s"),
  1159	                "errors": {},
  1160	                "capture_skipped": True,
  1161	                "skip_reason": "fake_clock",
  1162	            }
  1163	        else:
  1164	            observation = collect_environment_guard_observation(
  1165	                include_adapter_power=True
  1166	            )
  1167	            observation["capture_skipped"] = False
  1168	        observation["phase"] = phase
  1169	        if self._environment_admission is not None:
  1170	            self._environment_admission.setdefault("guard_observations", []).append(
  1171	                observation
  1172	            )
  1173	        return observation
  1174	
  1175	    def _enforce_post_capture_admission_guard(self, attempt: int) -> None:
  1176	        observation = self._admission_guard_observation(f"after_attempt_{attempt}")
  1177	        environment_reason = self._admission_environment_failure(observation)
  1178	        if environment_reason is None:
  1179	            return
  1180	        assert self._environment_admission is not None
  1181	        self._environment_admission.update(
  1182	            {"decision": "abort", "failure": environment_reason}
  1183	        )
  1184	        raise _StageFailure(
  1185	            "idle_baseline", FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR, environment_reason
  1185	            "idle_baseline", FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR, environment_reason
  1186	        )
  1187	
  1188	    @staticmethod
  1189	    def _admission_environment_failure(
  1190	        observation: dict[str, Any],
  1191	    ) -> str | None:
  1192	        return environment_observation_failure(observation)
  1193	
  1194	    def _stage_warmup(self) -> None:
  1195	        self._begin_stage("warmup")
  1196	        assert self._runtime is not None
  1197	        warmup_runs = self._config.workload_profile.warmup_runs
  1198	        for index in range(warmup_runs):
  1199	            result = self._runtime.warmup(self._config, self._context)
  1200	            self._check(result, "warmup", f"runtime warmup run {index} failed")
  1201	            self._capture_adapter_alignments()
  1202	        self._log(self._runtime_log, f"completed {warmup_runs} warmup run(s)")
  1203	        warmup_seconds = self._config.sampling.warmup_seconds
  1204	        if warmup_seconds > 0.0:
  1205	            self._log(
  1206	                self._runtime_log,
  1207	                f"post-warmup settling for {warmup_seconds} s before sampling",
  1208	            )
  1209	            self._clock.sleep(warmup_seconds)
  1210	        self._complete_stage(
  1211	            "warmup",
  1212	            {"warmup_runs": warmup_runs, "warmup_seconds": warmup_seconds},
  1213	        )
  1214	
  1215	    def _stage_measured_run(self) -> None:
  1216	        self._begin_stage("measured_run")
  1217	        assert self._runtime is not None and self._telemetry is not None
  1218	        self._thermal_pre = self._telemetry.thermal_state(self._config, self._context)
  1219	        self._sampling_start_in_progress = True
  1220	        try:
  1221	            start_result = self._telemetry.start_sampling(self._config, self._context)
  1222	        except BaseException:
  1223	            # Finalization must treat the sampler as potentially live if start
  1224	            # was interrupted after it created native capture state.
  1225	            raise
  1226	        else:
  1227	            # Keep liveness continuous across the successful-start transition:
  1228	            # an interrupt between these assignments still leaves at least one
  1229	            # flag set, so finalization stops the sampler before custody salvage.
  1230	            self._sampling_active = True
  1231	            self._sampling_start_in_progress = False
  1232	        self._telemetry_metadata = dict(start_result.metadata)
  1233	        self._check(start_result, "measured_run", "telemetry start_sampling failed")
  1234	        self._capture_adapter_alignments()
  1235	        self._capture_adapter_metadata()
  1236	        # D-026: the measured window the reducer integrates is bounded by the
  1237	        # sampling_started/sampling_stopped marker events, not the stage
  1238	        # boundaries, so sampler spawn latency (sudo probe, process start,
  1239	        # first sample) and stop-side parsing stay outside the window. The
  1240	        # start marker is stamped only after start_sampling confirms; the stop
  1241	        # marker is stamped before stop_sampling is asked to wind down.
  1242	        sampling_started_stamp = _clock_stamp(self._clock)
  1243	        self._sampling_started_stamp = sampling_started_stamp
  1244	        self._events.append(
  1245	            RuntimeEvent(
  1246	                timestamp_s=sampling_started_stamp.epoch_s,
  1247	                event_type="sampling_started",
  1248	                phase="measured_run",
  1249	                message="telemetry sampling confirmed active",
  1250	                metadata={},
  1251	            )
  1252	        )
  1253	        # D-013 quiescent window: between the sampling_started stamp and the
  1254	        # sampling_stopped stamp the controller only blocks on the runtime -
  1255	        # no file writes, no disk event appends, no logging (buffers flush
  1256	        # after the window; alignment capture runs after the stop stamp).
  1257	        if self._suite_manifest is not None:
  1258	            assert self._suite_order_seed is not None

   994	                raise _StageFailure(

   998	                reason = "critical per-run environment policy did not pass"

  1000	                    {"decision": "abort", "failure": reason}
  1001	                )

  1003	                    "idle_baseline", FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR, reason
  1004	                )
  1005	
  1006	        if admission is not None and admission.enabled:
  1007	            begin_sampling = getattr(
  1008	                self._telemetry, "begin_admission_window_sampling", None
  1009	            )
  1010	            if callable(begin_sampling):
  1011	                self._sampling_start_in_progress = True
  1012	                result = begin_sampling(self._config, self._context)
  1013	                self._check(
  1014	                    result,
  1015	                    "idle_baseline",
  1016	                    "telemetry admission-window sampling failed",
  1017	                )

  1019	        self._baseline = self._measure_idle_admission_attempt(1, attempts)
  1020	        if admission is not None and admission.enabled:
  1021	            self._enforce_post_capture_admission_guard(1)
  1022	            if not attempts[-1]["admitted"]:
  1023	                observation = self._admission_guard_observation("before_attempt_2")

  1028	                        {"decision": "abort", "failure": environment_reason}
  1029	                    )

  1031	                        "idle_baseline",
  1032	                        FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR,
  1033	                        environment_reason,
  1034	                    )
  1035	                self._baseline = self._measure_idle_admission_attempt(2, attempts)
  1036	                self._enforce_post_capture_admission_guard(2)
  1037	            assert self._environment_admission is not None
  1038	            if attempts[-1]["admitted"]:
  1039	                final_attempt = attempts[-1].get("attempt")
  1040	                promote_attempt = getattr(
  1041	                    self._telemetry, "promote_idle_admission_attempt", None
  1042	                )
  1043	                if (
  1044	                    isinstance(final_attempt, int)
  1045	                    and final_attempt > 1
  1046	                    and callable(promote_attempt)
  1047	                ):
  1048	                    promote_attempt(
  1049	                        run_id=self._context.run_id,
  1050	                        attempt=final_attempt,
  1051	                        context=self._context,
  1052	                    )

  1059	                        "failure": reason,
  1060	                        "claim_reason": "environment_admission_failed",

  1070	                        "claim_reason": "environment_admission_failed",
  1071	                    }
  1072	                )

  1080	                        "claim_reason": "environment_admission_failed",

  1084	            self._telemetry_log,

  1102	    def _measure_idle_admission_attempt(
  1103	        self, attempt: int, attempts: list[dict[str, Any]]
  1104	    ) -> IdleBaseline:
  1105	        assert self._telemetry is not None
  1106	        attempt_start_s = self._clock.now()
  1107	        baseline = self._telemetry.measure_idle(self._config, self._context)
  1108	        attempt_end_s = self._clock.now()
  1109	        self._capture_adapter_alignments()
  1110	        self._capture_adapter_metadata()
  1111	        if self._campaign_policy is not None:
  1112	            gpu_admitted = baseline.idle_window_suspect is False
  1113	            row: dict[str, Any] = {
  1114	                "attempt": attempt,
  1115	                "start_s": attempt_start_s,
  1116	                "end_s": attempt_end_s,
  1117	                "baseline": _jsonable(asdict(baseline)),
  1118	                "admitted": gpu_admitted,
  1119	            }
  1120	            extension = self._campaign_policy.idle_admission_extension
  1121	            if extension is not None:
  1122	                records = _adapter_idle_admission_records(
  1123	                    self._telemetry,
  1124	                    run_id=self._context.run_id,
  1125	                    attempt=attempt,
  1126	                )
  1127	                cpu_admission = evaluate_cpu_idle_admission(
  1128	                    records,
  1129	                    extension.cpu_criteria,
  1130	                    gpu_admitted=gpu_admitted,
  1131	                )
  1132	                cpu_enforced = records is not None or not isinstance(
  1133	                    self._clock, FakeClock
  1134	                )
  1135	                row.update(
  1136	                    {
  1137	                        "gpu_admitted": gpu_admitted,
  1138	                        "cpu_admission": cpu_admission,
  1139	                        "cpu_admission_enforced": cpu_enforced,
  1140	                        "admitted": (
  1141	                            cpu_admission["admitted"]
  1142	                            if cpu_enforced
  1143	                            else gpu_admitted
  1144	                        ),
  1145	                    }
  1146	                )
  1147	            attempts.append(row)
  1148	        return baseline

  1150	    def _admission_guard_observation(self, phase: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
  1151	        if isinstance(self._clock, FakeClock):
  1152	            source = self._environment if isinstance(self._environment, dict) else {}
  1153	            observation = {
  1154	                "display_power_state": source.get("display_power_state"),
  1155	                "screensaver_engaged": source.get("screensaver_engaged"),
  1156	                "screensaver_module": source.get("screensaver_module"),
  1157	                "screensaver_delay_s": source.get("screensaver_delay_s"),
  1158	                "hid_idle_s": source.get("hid_idle_s"),
  1159	                "errors": {},
  1160	                "capture_skipped": True,
  1161	                "skip_reason": "fake_clock",
  1162	            }
  1163	        else:
  1164	            observation = collect_environment_guard_observation(
  1165	                include_adapter_power=True
  1166	            )
  1167	            observation["capture_skipped"] = False
  1168	        observation["phase"] = phase
  1169	        if self._environment_admission is not None:
  1170	            self._environment_admission.setdefault("guard_observations", []).append(
  1171	                observation
  1172	            )
  1173	        return observation

  1175	    def _enforce_post_capture_admission_guard(self, attempt: int) -> None:
  1176	        observation = self._admission_guard_observation(f"after_attempt_{attempt}")
  1177	        environment_reason = self._admission_environment_failure(observation)
  1178	        if environment_reason is None:
  1179	            return
  1180	        assert self._environment_admission is not None
  1181	        self._environment_admission.update(
  1182	            {"decision": "abort", "failure": environment_reason}
  1183	        )
  1184	        raise _StageFailure(
  1185	            "idle_baseline", FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR, environment_reason
  1186	        )

  1189	    def _admission_environment_failure(
  1190	        observation: dict[str, Any],
  1191	    ) -> str | None:
  1192	        return environment_observation_failure(observation)

  1194	    def _stage_warmup(self) -> None:
  1195	        self._begin_stage("warmup")
  1196	        assert self._runtime is not None
  1197	        warmup_runs = self._config.workload_profile.warmup_runs
  1198	        for index in range(warmup_runs):
  1199	            result = self._runtime.warmup(self._config, self._context)
  1200	            self._check(result, "warmup", f"runtime warmup run {index} failed")
  1201	            self._capture_adapter_alignments()
  1202	        self._log(self._runtime_log, f"completed {warmup_runs} warmup run(s)")
  1203	        warmup_seconds = self._config.sampling.warmup_seconds
  1204	        if warmup_seconds > 0.0:
  1205	            self._log(
  1206	                self._runtime_log,
  1207	                f"post-warmup settling for {warmup_seconds} s before sampling",
  1208	            )
  1209	            self._clock.sleep(warmup_seconds)
  1210	        self._complete_stage(
  1211	            "warmup",
  1212	            {"warmup_runs": warmup_runs, "warmup_seconds": warmup_seconds},
  1213	        )

  1215	    def _stage_measured_run(self) -> None:
  1215	    def _stage_measured_run(self) -> None:
  1216	        self._begin_stage("measured_run")
  1217	        assert self._runtime is not None and self._telemetry is not None
  1218	        self._thermal_pre = self._telemetry.thermal_state(self._config, self._context)
  1219	        self._sampling_start_in_progress = True
  1220	        try:
  1221	            start_result = self._telemetry.start_sampling(self._config, self._context)
  1222	        except BaseException:
  1223	            # Finalization must treat the sampler as potentially live if start
  1224	            # was interrupted after it created native capture state.
  1225	            raise
  1226	        else:
  1227	            # Keep liveness continuous across the successful-start transition:
  1228	            # an interrupt between these assignments still leaves at least one
  1229	            # flag set, so finalization stops the sampler before custody salvage.
  1230	            self._sampling_active = True
  1231	            self._sampling_start_in_progress = False
  1232	        self._telemetry_metadata = dict(start_result.metadata)
  1233	        self._check(start_result, "measured_run", "telemetry start_sampling failed")
  1234	        self._capture_adapter_alignments()
  1235	        self._capture_adapter_metadata()
  1236	        # D-026: the measured window the reducer integrates is bounded by the
  1237	        # sampling_started/sampling_stopped marker events, not the stage
  1238	        # boundaries, so sampler spawn latency (sudo probe, process start,
  1239	        # first sample) and stop-side parsing stay outside the window. The
  1240	        # start marker is stamped only after start_sampling confirms; the stop
  1241	        # marker is stamped before stop_sampling is asked to wind down.
  1242	        sampling_started_stamp = _clock_stamp(self._clock)
  1243	        self._sampling_started_stamp = sampling_started_stamp
  1244	        self._events.append(
  1245	            RuntimeEvent(
  1246	                timestamp_s=sampling_started_stamp.epoch_s,
  1247	                event_type="sampling_started",
  1248	                phase="measured_run",
  1249	                message="telemetry sampling confirmed active",
  1250	                metadata={},
  1251	            )
  1252	        )
  1253	        # D-013 quiescent window: between the sampling_started stamp and the
  1254	        # sampling_stopped stamp the controller only blocks on the runtime -
  1255	        # no file writes, no disk event appends, no logging (buffers flush
  1256	        # after the window; alignment capture runs after the stop stamp).
  1257	        if self._suite_manifest is not None:
  1258	            assert self._suite_order_seed is not None
  1259	            runtime_result = self._runtime.run_suite(  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
  1260	                self._config,
  1261	                self._suite_manifest,
  1262	                self._context,
  1263	                order_seed=self._suite_order_seed,
  1264	                order_row=self._suite_order_row,
  1265	            )
  1266	        else:
  1267	            runtime_result = self._runtime.run_workload(self._config, self._context)
  1268	        # The stop marker's timestamp is captured as soon as the runtime
  1269	        # returns - before alignment capture and stop_sampling - so adapter
  1270	        # clock_alignments() getters (D-013 quiescent window) and the
  1271	        # sampler's wind-down (process stop, plist parsing) stay outside the
  1272	        # window; the event itself is appended after the runtime events so
  1273	        # the stable flush-sort keeps it bracketing them.
  1274	        sampling_stopped_stamp = _clock_stamp(self._clock)
  1275	        if self._post_window_sampling_dwell_s > 0.0:
  1276	            self._clock.sleep(self._post_window_sampling_dwell_s)
  1277	        self._capture_adapter_alignments()
  1278	        self._stop_sampling_once(sampling_stopped_stamp)
  1279	        self._record_trace_window_margins(
  1280	            sampling_started_stamp, sampling_stopped_stamp
  1281	        )
  1282	        self._capture_adapter_alignments()
  1283	        self._capture_adapter_metadata()
  1284	        self._sampling_active = False
  1285	        self._runtime_result = runtime_result
  1286	        self._thermal_post = self._telemetry.thermal_state(self._config, self._context)
  1287	        if self._is_axi_run():
  1288	            if runtime_result.axi_result is None:
  1289	                raise _StageFailure(
  1290	                    "measured_run",
  1291	                    FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR,
  1292	                    "AXI config requires request-scoped runtime result evidence",
  1293	                )
  1294	            self._events.extend(self._axi_request_events(runtime_result.axi_result))
  1295	        else:
  1296	            self._events.extend(runtime_result.events)
  1297	        self._events.append(
  1298	            RuntimeEvent(
  1299	                timestamp_s=sampling_stopped_stamp.epoch_s,
  1300	                event_type="sampling_stopped",
  1301	                phase="measured_run",
  1302	                message="measured window stopped; telemetry tail retained outside window",
  1303	                metadata={},
  1304	            )
  1305	        )
  1306	        self._write_outputs()
  1307	        self._write_trace()
  1308	        if self._is_axi_run() and runtime_result.axi_result is not None:
  1309	            unsuccessful = [
  1310	                request
  1311	                for request in runtime_result.axi_result.requests
  1312	                if request.admitted_at_s is not None
  1313	                and request.terminal_status != "succeeded"
  1314	            ]

  1316	                raise _StageFailure(
  1317	                    "measured_run",
  1318	                    FailureReason.UNKNOWN_ERROR,
  1319	                    "request-scoped runtime result contains non-succeeded terminal",
  1320	                )
  1321	        self._log(
  1322	            self._telemetry_log,
  1323	            f"measured window captured {len(self._samples)} power sample(s)",
  1324	        )
  1325	        self._complete_stage(
  1326	            "measured_run",
  1327	            {
  1328	                "sample_count": len(self._samples),
  1329	                "runtime_event_count": len(runtime_result.events),
  1330	            },
  1331	        )

  2404	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  2405	# Cooldown gate (D-014: idle-power recovery between live repetitions)
  2406	
  2407	
  2408	def cooldown_gate(
  2409	    telemetry: TelemetryAdapter,
  2410	    reference_baseline: IdleBaseline,
  2411	    config: BenchmarkConfig,
  2412	    clock: Clock,
  2413	    run_id: str | None = None,
  2414	    policy: CooldownPolicy | None = None,
  2415	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  2416	    """Hold for a complete sustained cooldown-v2 recovery window.
  2417	
  2418	    Sub-window means are weighted by their evidenced durations over the most
  2419	    recent complete sustained window.  Release requires both a complete
  2420	    wall-clock span and the policy's minimum evidence coverage, so small probe
  2421	    gaps neither prevent recovery nor masquerade as a complete window.
  2422	    Recovery is one-sided: values below the reference count as recovered.
  2423	    Thermal pressure must be nominal at release, and an optional calibrated
  2424	    absolute ceiling is an additional upper cap, never an alternative escape.
  2425	
  2426	    All blocking is via ``telemetry.measure_idle`` (which sleeps on the clock),
  2427	    so a ``FakeClock`` makes the gate instant and exact in tests.
  2428	
  2429	    ``run_id`` (NV-2/ARC-7): the gate calls ``measure_idle`` out-of-run with
  2430	    no ``RunContext``, so adapters that need a run id for node-side isolation
  2431	    fall back to ``config.run_id`` - which is ``None`` for generated-id
  2432	    experiments. When given, ``run_id`` is stamped onto the sub-window config
  2433	    so those adapters see a cooldown-scoped id instead of failing.
  2434	    """
  2435	    selected = policy if policy is not None else CooldownPolicy()
  2436	    reference = reference_baseline.power_w_mean
  2437	    sub_config = replace(
  2438	        config,
  2439	        run_id=run_id if run_id is not None else config.run_id,
  2440	        sampling=replace(config.sampling, idle_seconds=selected.subwindow_s),
  2441	    )
  2442	    start_s = clock.now()
  2443	    readings: list[tuple[float, float, float, float]] = []
  2444	    trace: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  2445	    while True:
  2446	        subwindow_start_s = clock.now()
  2447	        baseline = telemetry.measure_idle(sub_config)
  2448	        now_s = clock.now()
  2449	        duration_s = baseline.duration_s
  2450	        if not isinstance(duration_s, int | float) or duration_s <= 0.0:
  2451	            duration_s = max(0.0, now_s - subwindow_start_s)
  2452	        evidence_start_s = now_s - float(duration_s)
  2453	        # Do not let a backend-reported duration reach backward across the
  2454	        # actual start of this bounded capture.
  2455	        evidence_start_s = max(evidence_start_s, subwindow_start_s)
  2456	        readings.append(
  2457	            (subwindow_start_s, evidence_start_s, now_s, baseline.power_w_mean)
  2458	        )
  2459	        cutoff = now_s - selected.sustained_window_s
  2460	        readings = [reading for reading in readings if reading[2] > cutoff]
  2461	        weighted_sum = 0.0
  2462	        coverage_s = 0.0
  2463	        retained_start_s: float | None = None
  2464	        for capture_start, evidence_start, evidence_end, value in readings:
  2465	            clipped_start = max(evidence_start, cutoff)
  2466	            overlap_s = max(0.0, evidence_end - clipped_start)
  2467	            weighted_sum += overlap_s * value
  2468	            coverage_s += overlap_s
  2469	            if overlap_s > 0.0:
  2470	                retained_capture_start = max(capture_start, cutoff)
  2471	                retained_start_s = (
  2472	                    retained_capture_start
  2473	                    if retained_start_s is None
  2474	                    else min(retained_start_s, retained_capture_start)
  2475	                )
  2476	        rolling_mean = weighted_sum / coverage_s if coverage_s > 0.0 else None
  2477	        window_span_s = (
  2478	            max(0.0, now_s - retained_start_s)
  2479	            if retained_start_s is not None
  2480	            else 0.0
  2481	        )
  2482	        waited_s = now_s - start_s
  2483	        try:
  2484	            thermal = telemetry.thermal_state(sub_config)
  2485	            thermal_pressure = thermal.thermal_pressure
  2486	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - unknown thermal fails the conjunctive gate
  2487	            thermal_pressure = None
  2488	        thermal_nominal = (
  2489	            isinstance(thermal_pressure, str)
  2490	            and thermal_pressure.lower() in {"nominal", "normal"}
  2491	        )
  2492	        reference_upper_w = reference * (1.0 + selected.tolerance_fraction)
  2493	        effective_upper_w = reference_upper_w
  2494	        if selected.absolute_ceiling_w is not None:
  2495	            effective_upper_w = min(effective_upper_w, selected.absolute_ceiling_w)
  2496	        required_coverage_s = (
  2497	            selected.coverage_fraction * selected.sustained_window_s
  2498	        )
  2499	        span_complete = window_span_s + 1e-9 >= selected.sustained_window_s
  2500	        coverage_complete = coverage_s + 1e-9 >= required_coverage_s
  2501	        window_complete = span_complete and coverage_complete
  2502	        power_recovered = (
  2503	            rolling_mean is not None and rolling_mean <= effective_upper_w
  2504	        )
  2505	        release_criteria_met = bool(
  2506	            window_complete
  2507	            and power_recovered
  2508	            and (thermal_nominal or not selected.require_thermal_nominal)
  2509	        )
  2510	        cap_hit = waited_s >= selected.cap_s
  2511	        release_criteria_met_late = cap_hit and release_criteria_met
  2512	        trace.append(
  2513	            {
  2514	                "timestamp_s": now_s,
  2515	                "waited_s": waited_s,
  2516	                "rolling_mean_power_w": rolling_mean,
  2517	                "window_span_s": window_span_s,
  2518	                "window_coverage_s": coverage_s,
  2519	                "required_coverage_s": required_coverage_s,
  2520	                "span_complete": span_complete,
  2521	                "coverage_complete": coverage_complete,
  2522	                "window_complete": window_complete,
  2523	                "reference_upper_w": reference_upper_w,
  2524	                "absolute_ceiling_w": selected.absolute_ceiling_w,
  2525	                "effective_upper_w": effective_upper_w,
  2526	                "thermal_pressure": thermal_pressure,
  2527	                "thermal_nominal": thermal_nominal,
  2528	                "release": release_criteria_met and not cap_hit,
  2529	                "release_criteria_met_late": release_criteria_met_late,
  2530	                "baseline": _jsonable(asdict(baseline)),
  2531	            }
  2532	        )
  2533	        common = {
  2534	            "policy_version": selected.policy_version,
  2535	            "thresholds": {
  2536	                "subwindow_s": selected.subwindow_s,
  2537	                "sustained_window_s": selected.sustained_window_s,
  2538	                "coverage_fraction": selected.coverage_fraction,
  2539	                "tolerance_fraction": selected.tolerance_fraction,
  2540	                "cap_s": selected.cap_s,
  2541	                "absolute_ceiling_w": selected.absolute_ceiling_w,
  2542	                "require_thermal_nominal": selected.require_thermal_nominal,
  2543	            },
  2544	            "waited_s": waited_s,
  2545	            "reference_power_w": reference,
  2546	            "tolerance_fraction": selected.tolerance_fraction,
  2547	            "absolute_ceiling_w": selected.absolute_ceiling_w,
  2548	            "reference_upper_w": reference_upper_w,
  2549	            "effective_upper_w": effective_upper_w,
  2550	            "decision_rolling_mean_power_w": rolling_mean,
  2551	            "window_required_s": selected.sustained_window_s,

  2978	                            "preceding baseline is ineligible and no frozen clean "
  2979	                            "cooldown anchor is available"

  2982	                        "fail_closed_action": action.value,
  2983	                    }
  2984	                )

  2381	def summary_status(summary_path: Path) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
  2382	    try:
  2383	        summary = json.loads(summary_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
  2384	    except OSError as exc:
  2385	        return None, f"{summary_path}: {exc}"
  2386	    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
  2387	        return None, f"{summary_path}: malformed JSON ({exc.msg})"
  2388	    if not isinstance(summary, dict):
  2389	        return None, f"{summary_path}: summary_metrics.json is not a JSON object"
  2390	    status = summary.get("status")
  2391	    if not isinstance(status, str):
  2392	        return None, f"{summary_path}: summary_metrics.json lacks string status"
  2393	    return status, None

  4491	def _membership_manifest_descriptor(
  4492	    runs_dir: Path, record: Any
  4493	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  4494	    root = runs_dir.resolve()
  4495	    path = Path(record.path).resolve()
  4496	    return {
  4497	        "path": path.relative_to(root).as_posix(),
  4498	        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(record.raw_bytes).hexdigest(),
  4499	        "size": len(record.raw_bytes),
  4500	    }

  4503	def whole_window_membership_id(
  4504	    descriptors: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
  4505	) -> str:
  4506	    """Derive the null-identity membership id from the exact descriptor set."""
  4507	
  4508	    normalized = sorted(
  4509	        (dict(descriptor) for descriptor in descriptors),
  4510	        key=lambda row: str(row.get("path")),
  4511	    )
  4512	    return hashlib.sha256(
  4513	        json.dumps(
  4514	            normalized,
  4515	            sort_keys=True,
  4516	            separators=(",", ":"),
  4517	            ensure_ascii=False,
  4518	            allow_nan=False,
  4519	        ).encode("utf-8")
  4520	    ).hexdigest()

  4523	def load_window_membership_binding(
  4524	    path_text: str | Path,
  4525	    *,
  4526	    runs_dir: Path,
  4527	    policy_sha256: str,
  4528	    catalog: Sequence[Any],
  4529	) -> dict[str, Any]:
  4530	    """Authenticate an exhaustive binding for policy-matching null identities."""
  4531	
  4532	    path = Path(path_text).resolve(strict=True)
  4533	    try:
  4534	        raw = path.read_bytes()
  4535	        value = json.loads(raw)
  4536	    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
  4537	        raise ValueError("window membership binding is unreadable") from exc
  4538	    if not isinstance(value, dict):
  4539	        raise ValueError("window membership binding is not an object")
  4540	    expected = [
  4541	        _membership_manifest_descriptor(runs_dir, record)
  4542	        for record in catalog
  4543	        if record.value.get("analysis_manifest_id") is None
  4544	        and isinstance(record.value.get("campaign_policy"), Mapping)
  4545	        and record.value["campaign_policy"].get("sha256") == policy_sha256
  4546	    ]
  4547	    expected = sorted(expected, key=lambda row: row["path"])
  4548	    supplied = value.get("source_campaign_manifests")
  4549	    membership_id = whole_window_membership_id(expected)
  4550	    if (
  4551	        value.get("schema_version") != MEMBERSHIP_BINDING_SCHEMA
  4552	        or value.get("campaign_policy_sha256") != policy_sha256
  4553	        or supplied != expected
  4554	        or value.get("membership_id") != membership_id
  4555	    ):
  4556	        raise ValueError("window membership binding is not exhaustive/authenticated")
  4557	    return {
  4558	        **value,
  4559	        "path": str(path),
  4560	        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
  4561	        "size": len(raw),
  4562	    }

  4565	def _whole_window_campaign_membership(

  4640	                                or not isinstance(path_text, str)

  4705	                bundle_ids = member.get("bundle_ids")
  4706	                if isinstance(bundle_ids, list):
  4707	                    valid_bundle_ids = [
  4708	                        value for value in bundle_ids if isinstance(value, str) and value
  4709	                    ]
  4710	                    group["bundle_ids"].extend(valid_bundle_ids)
  4711	                    provenance = {
  4712	                        "config_name": (
  4713	                            member.get("config")
  4714	                            if isinstance(member.get("config"), str)
  4715	                            else None
  4716	                        ),
  4717	                        "run_id": (
  4718	                            member.get("run_id")
  4719	                            if isinstance(member.get("run_id"), str)
  4720	                            else None
  4721	                        ),
  4722	                        "role": member.get("role") if isinstance(member.get("role"), str) else None,
  4723	                        "sentinel_position": (
  4724	                            member.get("sentinel_position")
  4725	                            if isinstance(member.get("sentinel_position"), str)
  4726	                            else None
  4727	                        ),
  4728	                        "scientific_config_sha256": (
  4729	                            member.get("scientific_config_sha256")
  4730	                            if isinstance(member.get("scientific_config_sha256"), str)
  4731	                            else None

  5145	def run_whole_window_verdict(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
  5146	    """Emit the prospective NEG-8 verdict across a completed runs root."""
  5147	
  5148	    runs_dir = Path(args.runs_dir)
  5149	    if not runs_dir.is_dir():
  5150	        raise ValueError(f"--runs-dir is not a directory: {runs_dir}")
  5151	    log_path = Path(args.log) if args.log else runs_dir / "campaign_log.jsonl"
  5152	    _require_external_campaign_log(log_path)
  5153	    lock_token = acquire_campaign_lock(runs_dir)
  5154	    in_flight: BaseException | None = None
  5155	    try:
  5156	        return _run_whole_window_verdict_locked(
  5157	            args, runs_dir=runs_dir, log_path=log_path, lock_token=lock_token
  5158	        )
  5159	    except BaseException as exc:
  5160	        in_flight = exc
  5161	        raise
  5162	    finally:
  5163	        release_campaign_lock(lock_token, in_flight=in_flight)

  5166	def _run_whole_window_verdict_locked(
  5167	    args: argparse.Namespace,
  5168	    *,
  5169	    runs_dir: Path,
  5170	    log_path: Path,
  5171	    lock_token: CampaignLockToken,
  5172	) -> int:
  5173	    """Evaluate and append the whole-window verdict under the campaign lock."""
  5174

  5176	    policy_binding = load_campaign_policy(args.campaign_policy)

  5195	    source_manifests = list(membership.source_manifests)

  5202	    waived = [evaluation for evaluation in evaluations if evaluation.waived]
  5203	    excluded = [evaluation for evaluation in evaluations if evaluation.failed]

  5206	        "consumption_semantics_id",
  5207	        MINTED_CONSUMPTION_SEMANTICS_ID,

  5209	    consumption_session: AuthenticatedConsumptionSession | None = None

  5213	        SALVAGE_DANGLER_CONSUMPTION_SEMANTICS_ID,
  5214	    }:
  5215	        consumption_session = AuthenticatedConsumptionSession(
  5216	            runs_dir,

  5218	            consumption_semantics_id=consumption_semantics_id,
  5219	        )
  5220	        consumption_session._prepare(
  5221	            bundle_paths={
  5222	                evaluation.bundle_id: evaluation.bundle_path
  5223	                for evaluation in included
  5224	            },
  5225	            policy=policy_binding.policy,
  5226	        )

  5228	            raise ValueError(

  5234	                evaluation,

  5237	                ),
  5238	            )
  5239	            for evaluation in included
  5240	        ]
  5241	        consumption_provenance = {
  5242	            evaluation.bundle_id: dict(provenance)

  5245	                (

  5249	                ),

  5251	            )
  5252	        }

  5255	    core = idle_admission_core_verdict(

  5260	        neg8_drift_bound=neg8_drift_bound,

  5265	        ),
  5266	    )

  5268	    core_conditions.update(selection_conditions)

  5295	    elif policy_binding.policy.profile.value == "exploratory":

  5297	    else:

  5300	    basis = build_evaluation_basis(

  5302	        member_occurrences=_basis_member_occurrences(included, runs_dir),

  5373	def _manifest_readiness_reasons(state: AnalysisManifestState) -> list[str]:
  5374	    reasons = {"analysis_manifest_invalid"}
  5375	    for problem in state.problems:
  5376	        if "freeze_status" in problem or "not frozen" in problem:
  5377	            reasons.add("analysis_manifest_not_frozen")
  5378	        if "order_manifest.sha256" in problem and (
  5379	            "mismatch" in problem or "source hash mismatch" in problem
  5380	        ):
  5381	            reasons.add("order_manifest_hash_mismatch")
  5382	        if "config_sha256" in problem and (
  5383	            "mismatch" in problem or "does not match config bytes" in problem

  5389	def _precheck_for_contrast(
  5390	    summary: dict[str, Any] | None, contrast: dict[str, Any]
  5391	) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
  5392	    if not isinstance(summary, dict):
  5393	        return None
  5394	    root = summary.get("window_evidence_precheck")
  5395	    if not isinstance(root, dict):
  5396	        return None
  5397	    metric = contrast.get("metric")
  5398	    if not isinstance(metric, dict):
  5399	        return None
  5400	    metric = estimation_metric(metric)
  5401	    metric_name = metric.get("name")
  5402	    metric_tag = metric.get("metric_tag")
  5403	    if metric_tag == "gross_request" or metric_name == "gross_energy_j":
  5404	        value = root.get("gross_request")
  5405	        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None
  5406	    if metric_tag == "idle_request" or metric_name in {
  5407	        "energy_request_j",
  5408	        "idle_subtracted_energy_j",
  5409	    }:
  5410	        value = root.get("idle_subtracted_request")
  5411	        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None
  5412	    if isinstance(metric_name, str) and metric_name.startswith("phase_energy_j."):
  5413	        phase = root.get("phase")
  5414	        phase_name = metric_name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
  5415	        value = phase.get(phase_name) if isinstance(phase, dict) and phase_name else None
  5416	        return value if isinstance(value, dict) else None
  5417	    return None
  5418	
  5419	
  5420	def _metric_is_finite(summary: dict[str, Any] | None, contrast: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
  5421	    if not isinstance(summary, dict):
  5422	        return False
  5423	    metric = contrast.get("metric")
  5424	    metric = estimation_metric(metric) if isinstance(metric, dict) else metric
  5425	    metric_name = metric.get("name") if isinstance(metric, dict) else None
  5426	    if not isinstance(metric_name, str) or not metric_name:
  5427	        return False
  5428	    value: Any = summary
  5429	    for part in metric_name.split("."):
  5430	        if not isinstance(value, dict) or part not in value:
  5431	            return False
  5432	        value = value[part]
  5433	    return (
  5434	        not isinstance(value, bool)
  5435	        and isinstance(value, int | float)
  5436	        and math.isfinite(float(value))
  5437	    )

  5440	def _contrast_uses_idle_subtraction(contrast: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
  5441	    metric = contrast.get("metric")
  5442	    if not isinstance(metric, dict):
  5443	        return False
  5444	    metric = estimation_metric(metric)
  5445	    return metric.get("metric_tag") == "idle_request" or metric.get("name") in {
  5446	        "energy_request_j",
  5447	        "idle_subtracted_energy_j",
  5448	    }

  5451	def _member_readiness_reasons(
  5452	    evaluation: MemberEvaluation, contrast: dict[str, Any]
  5453	) -> list[str]:
  5454	    reasons: set[str] = set()
  5455	    if not evaluation.strict_valid:
  5456	        reasons.add("bundle_strict_invalid")
  5457	    if evaluation.status != "succeeded":
  5458	        reasons.add("bundle_status_not_succeeded")
  5459	    # "ready_for_analysis" is a governance assertion: replay-only wires may
  5460	    # validate strictly, but only the registered claim-eligible mints can be
  5461	    # declared ready (confirmation-round-4 P1 — non-current wires formerly
  5462	    # reached readiness and relied on downstream barriers alone). Mock
  5463	    # telemetry stays version-exempt: it cannot bear claims regardless.
  5464	    summary_provenance = (
  5465	        evaluation.summary.get("summary_provenance")
  5466	        if isinstance(evaluation.summary, dict)
  5467	        else None
  5468	    )
  5469	    readiness_reducer_version = (
  5470	        summary_provenance.get("reducer_version")
  5471	        if isinstance(summary_provenance, dict)
  5472	        else None
  5473	    )
  5474	    readiness_telemetry_identity = custody_telemetry_identity(
  5475	        evaluation.bundle_path,
  5476	        summary=evaluation.summary,
  5477	        metadata=evaluation.metadata,
  5478	    )
  5479	    if (
  5480	        not readiness_telemetry_identity.production_predicate_exempt
  5481	        and readiness_reducer_version not in {"0.5.2", "0.6.2"}
  5482	    ):
  5483	        reasons.add("reducer_wire_unknown")
  5484	    if isinstance(evaluation.metadata, dict):
  5485	        current_environment_reasons = _current_member_environment_refusals(evaluation)
  5486	        reasons.update(current_environment_reasons)
  5487	        if (
  5488	            not readiness_telemetry_identity.production_predicate_exempt
  5489	            and not current_environment_reasons
  5490	        ):
  5491	            reasons.update(post_run_environment_refusals(evaluation.metadata))
  5492	    cleanup_flags = {
  5493	        "runtime_cleanup_ok",
  5494	        "remote_cleanup_failed",
  5495	    }
  5496	    if cleanup_flags & set(evaluation.unwaived_claim_evidence_flags()):
  5497	        reasons.add("required_error_term_unknown")
  5498	    if "config_manifest_mismatch" in evaluation.collection_integrity_flags:
  5499	        reasons.add("config_hash_mismatch")
  5500	    if not _metric_is_finite(evaluation.summary, contrast):
  5501	        reasons.add("metric_missing_or_nonfinite")
  5502	    precheck = _precheck_for_contrast(evaluation.summary, contrast)
  5503	    if precheck is None:
  5504	        reasons.add("window_evidence_precheck_missing")
  5505	    else:
  5506	        embedded = precheck.get("reasons")
  5507	        if isinstance(embedded, list):
  5508	            reasons.update(reason for reason in embedded if isinstance(reason, str))
  5509	        else:
  5510	            reasons.add("window_evidence_precheck_missing")
  5511	        if precheck.get("eligible") is not True and not embedded:
  5512	            reasons.add("window_evidence_precheck_missing")
  5513	
  5514	    cooldown = evaluation.preceding_campaign_cooldown
  5515	    cooldown_result = cooldown.get("result") if isinstance(cooldown, dict) else None
  5516	    raw_verified = (
  5517	        isinstance(cooldown, dict)
  5518	        and verify_cooldown_raw_provenance(
  5519	            cooldown, evaluation.bundle_path.parent / "campaign_manifests"
  5520	        )
  5521	    )
  5522	    if cooldown_result == "cap_hit":
  5523	        reasons.add("cooldown_cap_hit")
  5524	        if not raw_verified:
  5525	            reasons.add("campaign_cooldown_evidence_missing")
  5526	    elif cooldown_result == "recovered" and not raw_verified:
  5527	        reasons.add("campaign_cooldown_evidence_missing")
  5528	    elif cooldown_result not in ACCEPTED_CAMPAIGN_COOLDOWN_RESULTS:
  5529	        reasons.add("campaign_cooldown_evidence_missing")
  5530	
  5531	    quality = evaluation.summary.get("measurement_quality") if evaluation.summary else None
  5532	    if isinstance(quality, dict) and quality.get("cooldown_cap_hit") is True:
  5533	        reasons.add("cooldown_cap_hit")
  5534	
  5535	    if _contrast_uses_idle_subtraction(contrast):
  5536	        idle_state = quality.get("idle_window_suspect") if isinstance(quality, dict) else None
  5537	        if idle_state is True:
  5538	            reasons.add("idle_window_suspect")
  5539	        elif idle_state is not False:
  5540	            reasons.add("idle_window_suspect_unknown")
  5541	    metric = contrast.get("metric")
  5542	    if isinstance(metric, dict) and metric.get("ratio_estimand") is not None:
  5543	        reasons.update(
  5544	            ratio_evidence_reasons(
  5545	                evaluation.ratio_token_provenance,
  5546	                evaluation.ratio_token_provenance,
  5547	            )
  5548	        )
  5549	    return sorted(reasons)
