  2396	def existing_state(info: ConfigInfo, runs_dir: Path) -> ExistingState:
  2397	    if info.repetitions == 1:
  2398	        bundle_dir = runs_dir / info.run_id
  2399	        summary_path = bundle_dir / "summary_metrics.json"
  2400	        if summary_path.is_file():
  2401	            status, malformed = summary_status(summary_path)
  2402	            if malformed is not None:
  2403	                return ExistingState(
  2404	                    action="incomplete existing",
  2405	                    inspect_members=(bundle_dir.name,),
  2406	                    malformed_summaries=(malformed,),
  2407	                )
  2408	            return ExistingState(action="skip complete")
  2409	        if bundle_dir.exists():
  2410	            return ExistingState(action="incomplete existing", inspect_members=(bundle_dir.name,))
  2411	        return ExistingState(action="would run")
  2412	
  2413	    members = member_bundle_dirs(runs_dir, info.run_id, info.repetitions)
  2414	    summary_paths = [member / "summary_metrics.json" for member in members]
  2415	    malformed_summaries: list[str] = []
  2416	    statuses: list[str | None] = []
  2417	    for summary_path in summary_paths:
  2418	        if summary_path.is_file():
  2419	            status, malformed = summary_status(summary_path)
  2420	            statuses.append(status)
  2421	            if malformed is not None:
  2422	                malformed_summaries.append(malformed)
  2423	        else:
  2424	            statuses.append(None)
  2425	    if malformed_summaries:
  2426	        inspect = tuple(member.name for member in members if member.exists())
  2427	        return ExistingState(
  2428	            action="incomplete existing",
  2429	            inspect_members=inspect,
  2430	            malformed_summaries=tuple(malformed_summaries),
  2431	        )
  2432	    if all(summary_path.is_file() for summary_path in summary_paths):
  2433	        non_succeeded = tuple(
  2434	            member.name
  2435	            for member, status in zip(members, statuses, strict=True)
  2436	            if status != "succeeded"
  2437	        )
  2438	        return ExistingState(
  2439	            action="skip complete",
  2440	            members_succeeded=sum(status == "succeeded" for status in statuses),
  2441	            members_total=len(members),
  2442	            non_succeeded_members=non_succeeded,
  2443	        )
  2444	    if any(member.exists() for member in members):
  2445	        inspect = tuple(member.name for member in members if member.exists())
  2446	        return ExistingState(action="incomplete existing", inspect_members=inspect)
  2447	    return ExistingState(action="would run")

  3301	    evaluation: MemberEvaluation,

  3303	    """Return fail-closed eligibility for a baseline used by cooldown v2."""
  3304	
  3305	    reasons: list[str] = []
  3306	    baseline = _idle_baseline_from_summary(evaluation.summary)
  3307	    if baseline is None:
  3308	        reasons.append("idle_baseline_unavailable")
  3309	    elif baseline.idle_window_suspect is not False:
  3310	        reasons.append("idle_window_not_clean")
  3311	    metadata = evaluation.metadata
  3312	    admission = metadata.get("environment_admission") if isinstance(metadata, dict) else None
  3313	    policy_binding = metadata.get("campaign_policy") if isinstance(metadata, dict) else None
  3314	    if not isinstance(admission, dict):
  3315	        reasons.append("environment_admission_provenance_missing")
  3316	    else:
  3317	        if admission.get("critical_environment_passed") is not True:
  3318	            reasons.append("critical_environment_not_passed")
  3319	        if admission.get("decision") != "admitted":
  3320	            reasons.append("idle_admission_not_passed")
  3321	        if admission.get("reference_provenance_present") is not True:
  3322	            reasons.append("reference_provenance_incomplete")
  3323	    if (
  3324	        not isinstance(policy_binding, dict)
  3325	        or not isinstance(policy_binding.get("sha256"), str)
  3326	        or not policy_binding.get("sha256")
  3327	    ):
  3328	        reasons.append("campaign_policy_provenance_missing")
  3329	    return {
  3330	        "bundle_id": evaluation.bundle_id,
  3331	        "eligible": baseline is not None and not reasons,
  3332	        "reasons": sorted(reasons),
  3333	        "idle_window_suspect": (
  3334	            baseline.idle_window_suspect if baseline is not None else None
  3335	        ),
  3336	        "critical_environment_passed": (
  3337	            admission.get("critical_environment_passed")
  3338	            if isinstance(admission, dict)

  3341	        "provenance_present": bool(
  3342	            isinstance(admission, dict)

  3344	            and isinstance(policy_binding, dict)
  3345	            and policy_binding.get("sha256")

The unattended path still has two credible full-window stranders and five lower-probability failure traps. Ranked by estimated night-loss probability:

1. **MAJOR — Transient admission-probe failures immediately stop the stage**

   Environment commands have a fixed 3-second timeout at [joulewise/environment.py:17](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/environment.py:17). A timeout becomes an unknown display/screensaver state, which admission rejects at [joulewise/environment_admission.py:24](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/environment_admission.py:24). Controller re-probes are one-shot and abort immediately at [joulewise/controller.py:988](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/controller.py:988) and [joulewise/controller.py:1175](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/controller.py:1175). With the campaign default of one failure at [scripts/run_campaign.py:598](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:598), the stage then stops at [scripts/run_campaign.py:7629](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:7629).

   **Failing scenario:** `system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType -json` takes 3.1 seconds during one otherwise-clean admission check. The state becomes “unknown,” one member fails, and the remaining unattended stage is abandoned. There is retry for contaminated idle capture, but none for the probe itself.

2. **BLOCKER — No workload watchdog; one hung runtime holds `campaign.lock` indefinitely**

   The campaign launches each child with an unbounded `subprocess.run` at [scripts/run_campaign.py:7485](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:7485). Controller calls the suite/runtime synchronously at [joulewise/controller.py:1257](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/controller.py:1257). The MLX streaming iterator likewise has no deadline at [joulewise/adapters/mlx_runtime.py:582](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/adapters/mlx_runtime.py:582).

   **Failing scenario:** Metal/MLX stalls mid-generation without throwing. The child never exits, the parent waits for the entire 2–4-hour window, the campaign lock remains held, and no later members or verdict run.

3. **MAJOR — A post-member aggregation error creates an unattended, non-resumable partial experiment**

   Aggregation runs after every completed repetition; any exception is marked `"retryable": true` but immediately re-raised at [joulewise/controller.py:2862](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/controller.py:2862). A relaunch classifies the existing partial repetition set as incomplete at [scripts/run_campaign.py:2396](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:2396), then treats that as another failure at [scripts/run_campaign.py:7324](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:7324).

   **Failing scenario:** repetition 3 finishes successfully, but aggregation hits a transient read/OSError. The child exits, the campaign stops, and restarting does not continue with repetition 4; it refuses the partial directory until an operator quarantines it.

4. **MAJOR — Stale `campaign.lock` after termination is still live**

   Lock acquisition uses `O_EXCL` and rejects every pre-existing lock without validating or reclaiming it at [scripts/run_campaign.py:2614](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:2614). Normal Python exception paths release it in `finally` at [scripts/run_campaign.py:7696](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:7696), but SIGTERM, SIGKILL, host loss, or interpreter failure bypass that cleanup. The existing live diagnosis already records this behavior at [DIAGNOSIS.md:32](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/docs/process_traces/2026-08-06-d110-remint-fork/DIAGNOSIS.md:32).

   **Failing scenario:** a hung campaign or slow verdict is killed. The next direct campaign launch refuses to start before member 1. The runbook’s shell helper can quarantine a dead-PID lock, but the runner itself cannot; PID reuse can also defeat that helper.

5. **MAJOR — Cooldown timeout uses adjustable wall time**

   `SystemClock.now()` returns `time.time()` at [joulewise/clock.py:55](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/clock.py:55). Cooldown elapsed time and cap enforcement subtract those wall-clock values at [joulewise/controller.py:2442](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/controller.py:2442) and [joulewise/controller.py:2482](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/controller.py:2482), rather than using a monotonic deadline.

   **Failing scenario:** the clock steps backward ten minutes during a five-minute cooldown while thermal/power recovery never passes. The gate waits roughly fifteen minutes; repeated corrections can postpone the cap indefinitely. The production runbook’s network-time shutdown reduces probability but does not fix the arithmetic.

6. **MAJOR, configuration-dependent — Relative `--runs-dir` path-doubling remains in whole-window verdict**

   Whole-window verdict preserves `args.runs_dir` as a relative path at [scripts/run_campaign.py:5148](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:5148). Provenance records paths already containing that root at [joulewise/campaign_provenance.py:693](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/campaign_provenance.py:693), then descriptor loading prefixes the root again at [joulewise/whole_window.py:1876](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/whole_window.py:1876).

   **Failing scenario:** `--runs-dir runs/window-1` collects all members, but verdict tries to read `/repo/runs/window-1/runs/window-1/campaign_manifests/...` and exits without issuing the verdict. Absolute runs directories avoid it; the relative-path bug itself is not fixed.

7. **SHOULD-FIX — Verdict remains unbounded, serial, opaque, and empirically exceeds two minutes**

   Verdict serially strict-validates every source member at [scripts/run_campaign.py:5198](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:5198). Each member performs strict raw-evidence re-reduction through [scripts/run_campaign.py:4337](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/scripts/run_campaign.py:4337) and [joulewise/cli.py:379](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/joulewise/cli.py:379). There is no deadline or per-member progress. Existing live evidence confirms runtime beyond two minutes at [DIAGNOSIS.md:37](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-edr-code-JouleWise/58ce57f7-1ee6-4b35-a1b3-457ccf40dff7/scratchpad/desk/docs/process_traces/2026-08-06-d110-remint-fork/DIAGNOSIS.md:37).

   **Failing scenario:** a large window appears hung during verdict, is killed by an operator/watchdog, and leaves the stale lock described above. The measurement data survives, but verdict issuance and unattended closeout do not.

The one-failure stage stop and manual member quarantine are deliberate current policy, not accidental retry bugs. They materially amplify findings 1 and 3: no unattended retry slot exists for either transient admission failure or a partially completed experiment.

Review was read-only; no files were changed and no measurement or quiet-machine commands were run.
